from manim import *

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

class Section5Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        lecture_lines = [
            "High-dimensional volume behaves in counter-intuitive ways.",
            "Most volume stays extremely close to the surface.",
            "Think of peeling a 1,000-dimensional orange.",
            "A thin peel contains nearly all the fruit's mass.",
            "Volume also concentrates heavily around the equator."
        ]
        self.setup_layout("Concentration of Measure", lecture_lines)
        
        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        self.lecture[0].set_color("#FFFF00")
        # Visualizing a sphere (2D representation)
        sphere = Circle(radius=1.5, color=WHITE, fill_opacity=0.2)
        self.place_in_area(sphere, 'B3', 'E5')
        self.play(Create(sphere))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        self.lecture[0].set_color(WHITE)
        self.lecture[1].set_color("#FFFF00")
        
        # Thin outer shell
        shell = Annulus(inner_radius=1.45, outer_radius=1.5, color="#FFFF00", fill_opacity=0.8)
        shell.move_to(sphere.get_center())
        
        self.play(DrawBorderThenFill(shell))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        self.lecture[1].set_color(WHITE)
        self.lecture[2].set_color("#FFA500") # Orange color
        
        # Change sphere to orange-ish to represent the "Orange" analogy
        orange_fill = Circle(radius=1.5, color="#FFA500", fill_opacity=0.3)
        orange_fill.move_to(sphere.get_center())
        
        self.play(FadeIn(orange_fill), sphere.animate.set_color("#808080"))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 4 ===
        self.lecture[2].set_color(WHITE)
        self.lecture[3].set_color("#FFFF00")
        
        # Label the shell
        shell_label = MathTex(r"99.9\% \text{ of Volume}", color="#FFFF00", font_size=24)
        self.place_in_area(shell_label, 'B2', 'B6')
        
        # Highlight the center as being "empty" or less mass
        center_mass_label = Text("Minimal Mass", color="#808080", font_size=20)
        center_mass_label.move_to(sphere.get_center())
        
        self.play(Write(shell_label), FadeIn(center_mass_label))
        self.play(orange_fill.animate.set_fill(color="#808080", opacity=0.1))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 5 ===
        self.lecture[3].set_color(WHITE)
        self.lecture[4].set_color("#00FFFF") # Cyan for equator
        
        # Equator concentration visual
        # A horizontal strip representing volume near the equator
        equator_strip = Rectangle(height=0.3, width=3.0, color="#00FFFF", fill_opacity=0.6)
        equator_strip.move_to(sphere.get_center())
        
        equator_label = Text("Equator Concentration", color="#00FFFF", font_size=24)
        self.place_in_area(equator_label, 'F2', 'F6')
        
        self.play(
            FadeOut(shell_label),
            FadeOut(center_mass_label),
            shell.animate.set_stroke(opacity=0.3),
            Create(equator_strip),
            Write(equator_label)
        )
        self.wait(2)

        # Final cleanup
        self.play(self.lecture[4].set_color(WHITE))
        self.wait(2)
